title: dataset-eurlex production R-I-T coding matrix record (v1.1)
description: Common source-bounded relation record for the three-case production workflow. It is a proposal until researcher adjudication. Supersedes production-v1.0 by adding an explicit operative/recital evidentiary layer and a structured third-actor functional test, per PRODUCTION_CHANGELOG.md v1.1.

operative_anchor_location.description: The specific enacting-terms (article/paragraph/point) location that anchors this relation. Required (non-null) whenever relation_type is 'intermediated' or 'direct'. Null only for 'uncertain', 'not_supported', or when the only supporting text is a recital (in which case the finding belongs in the uncertainty log as a contextual candidate, not in the main matrix as a positive relation_type).

contextual_support.description: Recitals or other non-operative context consulted to interpret this relation. May be empty. Recitals here may explain purpose or institutional design; they never substitute for operative_anchor_location.

third_actor_test.description: Null when no third actor beyond R and T was seriously considered for this relation (e.g. a clean direct R-T relation, or a not_supported passage). Required (non-null) whenever I is non-empty, whenever relation_type is 'intermediated', and whenever a third actor was seriously considered and rejected (in which case the rejected candidate and this test still belong in the uncertainty log, not necessarily in the main matrix).

distinction.description: Is the candidate actor X analytically distinct from R and from T?

function.description: Does the text attribute to X a specific action or competence relevant to this relation?

regulatory_integration.description: Does that function participate in the way R affects, supervises, informs, evaluates, or structures T's conduct -- as opposed to merely supporting R's own internal process?

evidence.description: Is this connection supported by the normative (operative) text, not merely by a recital or by institutional plausibility?

counterfactual.description: If X's function were removed from the reconstruction, would a relevant step of the R-to-T regulatory mechanism be lost? ('NO' here is a strong signal against classifying X as I even if the other four dimensions lean YES.)
